    Deleting vertices along a covering #

    Appendix A, periodic-mesh-calculations.tex: "Paths lift uniquely from a chosen start. Contextual mesh relations lift to contextual mesh relations … The fixed-start lifting of paths and relations preserves nonvanishing", and "Delete all lifts of the two outer vertices of the long arms … (5.2) identifies the object quotient with the D₄ mesh category of the same period."

    The object quotient C(Q)/[D] is kQ modulo the mesh ideal plus the paths through D (oqFunctor_map_eq_zero_iff). We add the identities of the deleted vertices to a relation system (RelSystem.del), lift relations along a covering from a fixed start (ofStar_liftStar_mem), rescale to signed coefficients, and forget heights into Π(Δ) modulo the deleted vertices.

      Fixed-start lifting into Π(Δ) modulo deleted vertices. If a 𝟙 + b (π P) vanishes in the object quotient C(Q)/[D] for a path P : X → E with closed image, then b P and a 𝟙 vanish in Π(Δ) modulo the deleted vertices, after forgetting heights.
